sentences.en: Yeah, it was sort of widely agreed upon that there was a public interest in regulating and restricting sports betting, making it almost entirely illegal.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们大致达成共识，认为监管和限制体育博彩符合公众利益，使其几乎完全成为非法。

sentences.en: And they thought that gambling would compromise the integrity of their games.

sentences.en: Well, there's this specter of gambling-related cheating that hangs over American sports and particularly Major League Baseball,
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一种与赌博相关的作弊阴影笼罩着美国体育，特别是美国职业棒球大联盟，

sentences.en: which was nearly brought to its knees by the Black Sox scandal in 1919 when eight members of the Chicago White Sox were accused of throwing the World Series that year in exchange for money from a gambling syndicate.
sentences.zh: 它在1919年的“黑袜丑闻”中险些崩溃，当时芝加哥白袜队的八名成员被指控为了收取赌球集团的钱而在当年的世界大赛中打假球。

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: And then, you know, all the way up more recently.

sentences.en: By now, Nick, most everybody knows about the fate of Pete Rose, the hammer coming down today, and it came down hard.

sentences.en: With Pete Rose, who was caught betting on his team's games.
sentences.zh: 对于皮特·罗斯，他被发现在自己球队的比赛中下注。

sentences.en: I mean, the idea being that you would be influencing some sort of outcome by betting on the side.

sentences.en: So when did that start to change?

sentences.en: Well, it really started to change about 10 years ago.

sentences.en: And one of the main causes was the appearance of these two technology startups, Giraffe Kings and FanDuel.
sentences.zh: 其中一个主要原因是这两家科技初创公司DraftKings和FanDuel的出现。

sentences.en: And their business was what's known as fantasy sports.
sentences.zh: 他们的业务就是所谓的梦幻体育。

sentences.en: This is something that was probably familiar to a lot of people even before the digital age,
sentences.zh: 甚至在数字时代之前，这可能也是许多人熟悉的事情，

sentences.en: where friends would get together in one another's basements and pick these imaginary teams composed of real professional athletes.
sentences.zh: 朋友们会聚在彼此的地下室里，挑选由真实的职业运动员组成的虚拟球队。

sentences.en: And then based upon how the real athletes performed in games, the imaginary teams would earn points and win or lose based on that.
sentences.zh: 然后根据真实运动员在比赛中的表现，虚拟球队获得积分，并以此决出胜负。

sentences.en: So Giraffe Kings and FanDuel took this game and made it digital.
sentences.zh: 所以DraftKings和FanDuel把这个游戏数字化了。

sentences.en: You could do it online and play against not just your friends, but a much wider pool of people.
sentences.zh: 你不仅可以在线游玩，还可以与更广泛的人群对战。

sentences.en: And Giraffe Kings and FanDuel adapted one more aspect of fantasy sports,
sentences.zh: DraftKings和FanDuel还调整了梦幻体育的另一个方面，

sentences.en: putting money on the results of the performances of these imaginary teams and brought that into the digital age as well.
sentences.zh: 将真金白银押在这些虚拟球队的表现结果上，也将这一点带入了数字时代。

sentences.en: So now you could sit on your phone and pick your team and then stake money on whether your team won or lost and potentially make a lot more money doing that than you could have done just playing fantasy sports against your friends after your draft in their basement.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你可以坐在手机前挑选你的球队，然后押注你的球队是输是赢，通过这种方式，你可能比在地下室选秀后仅与朋友玩梦幻体育赚到更多的钱。

sentences.en: But that's starting to sound a lot like betting on sports, which is illegal, right?

sentences.en: They emerged really quickly.
sentences.zh: 它们崛起得非常快。

sentences.en: And like a lot of these disruptive tech companies, they found a sort of like legal gray area where there was a lot of demand and not a lot of specificity in the legal landscape.
sentences.zh: 就像许多这些颠覆性的科技公司一样，它们发现了一个法律灰色地带，那里有巨大的需求，但法律环境却缺乏明确性。

sentences.en: And they waltzed right into it and suddenly had a big business going, but had a lot of uncertainty about whether they were violating the federal ban,
sentences.zh: 它们大摇大摆地走了进去，突然间做起了大生意，但对于自己是否违反了联邦禁令，以及限制谁能提供赌博和可以提供何种赌博的州法律，充满了不确定性。

sentences.en: but also state laws that restricted who could offer gambling and what types of gambling could be offered.

sentences.en: So it's sort of like Uber and Lyft in a way, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这在某种程度上有点像优步和来福车，对吧？

sentences.en: Like startups that didn't wait to figure out the law.
sentences.zh: 就像那些没有弄清楚法律就先干起来的初创公司一样。

sentences.en: They just went for it and hoped that the law would follow.
sentences.zh: 它们只是勇往直前，希望法律能随后跟上。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a good analogy.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的比喻。

sentences.en: And these companies were already starting to see that they were going to face some legal challenges in states that seemed to be inclined to rule that this was illegal gambling,
sentences.zh: 这些公司已经开始看到，它们将在那些倾向于裁定这是非法赌博的州面临一些法律挑战，

sentences.en: which would put them in some serious trouble, really jeopardizing their whole business model.
sentences.zh: 这会让它们陷入严重的麻烦，真正危及它们的整个商业模式。

sentences.en: But as the threat of these legal challenges was starting to build, there was a lawyer who had begun taking an interest in these companies from afar,

sentences.zh: 他是一个名叫杰里米·库丹的人，他的专长是帮助这些年轻且具有颠覆性的行业应对各州首府的监管和立法挑战。

sentences.en: And he was looking for a new challenge.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在寻找新的挑战。

sentences.en: And it's actually interesting.
sentences.zh: 其实这很有趣。

sentences.en: He had pitched Uber on potentially working for them because they were sort of on the rise at this same point.

sentences.en: So it's a great analogy that you make, Sabrina.

sentences.en: But he's also a big sports fan.
sentences.zh: 但他也是个狂热的体育迷。

sentences.en: And he's a huge backer of the Yankees, the New York Rangers, also Alabama football, the New York Knicks.
sentences.zh: 他是纽约洋基队、纽约游骑兵队、还有阿拉巴马大学橄榄球队以及纽约尼克斯队的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: And he was sort of turned on to fantasy sports when he heard an ad on the radio in 2014 in which one of these companies was telling listeners that they could win a boatload of money through fantasy sports.
sentences.zh: 2014年他在收音机里听到一则广告，其中一家公司告诉听众他们可以通过梦幻体育赢得巨额资金，这启发了他对梦幻体育的兴趣。

sentences.en: And that was a little bit of a light bulb moment for him that led to him pitching FanDuel and ultimately signing both FanDuel and DraftKings.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是一个灵光一闪的时刻，促使他向FanDuel进行推销，并最终签下了FanDuel和DraftKings。

sentences.en: Okay, so he's working for these companies now.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以他现在为这些公司工作了。

sentences.en: What does he do?

sentences.en: He basically told them that they needed to develop a national strategy to go into states to try to pass legislation that would affirm the legality of this suddenly booming fantasy sports business.
sentences.zh: 他基本上告诉他们，他们需要制定一项国家战略，进入各州努力通过立法，以确认这个突然蓬勃发展的梦幻体育业务的合法性。

sentences.en: And basically what he needs to do is convince these state lawmakers and state officials that fantasy sports is not gambling and therefore does not violate states' laws on gambling nor the federal ban on sports betting.
sentences.zh: 他基本上需要做的是说服这些州的立法者和州官员，梦幻体育不是赌博，因此既不违反各州的赌博法律，也不违反联邦对体育博彩的禁令。

sentences.en: And a lot of these states predicate the definition of gambling on whether something is a game of chance, which is gambling, or a game of skill, which is not gambling.
sentences.zh: 许多州将赌博的定义建立在某事是运气游戏（属于赌博）还是技巧游戏（不属于赌博）的基础之上。

sentences.en: And so the argument is that in order to be successful at fantasy sports, you need to have skill and the players with the most skill will win.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们的论点是，要在梦幻体育中获得成功，你需要具备技巧，而技巧最高的玩家将会获胜。

sentences.en: And they produced a bunch of studies and they produced a bunch of legal analysis making that case.
sentences.zh: 他们制作了一堆研究报告，并出具了支持这一论点的法律分析。

sentences.en: And by the end of 2017, 19 states had passed bills legalizing fantasy sports.
sentences.zh: 到2017年底，有19个州通过了将梦幻体育合法化的法案。

sentences.en: And most, if not all, of those were written with help from Jeremy Kudan and his team of lobbyists.

sentences.en: Not sports gambling more broadly.
sentences.zh: 并不是更广泛意义上的体育赌博。

sentences.en: Well, it is just fantasy sports.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实只是梦幻体育。

sentences.en: But while this legal campaign is happening, DraftKings and FanDuel are doing pretty well.
sentences.zh: 但在这场法律运动进行的同时，DraftKings和FanDuel发展得相当不错。

sentences.en: They're attracting lots of users.
sentences.zh: 它们吸引了大量的用户。

sentences.en: And so their success showed that there was real potential for them to move into sports betting and to use fantasy sports as a stepping stone to that.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们的成功表明，它们有真正的潜力进军体育博彩领域，并以此作为切入点。

sentences.en: But they have two obstacles there.
sentences.zh: 但它们在那里有两个障碍。

sentences.en: One is getting the leagues on board.
sentences.zh: 一是让各大联盟加入进来。

sentences.en: And the second, of course, is this federal ban.
sentences.zh: 第二，当然就是这个联邦禁令。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So step one, get the leagues on board.
sentences.zh: 所以第一步，让联盟加入进来。

sentences.en: How do they do that?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Well, the leagues in some ways were a receptive audience.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从某些方面来看，各大联盟是一个乐于接受的听众。

sentences.en: They were struggling themselves with dwindling viewership and fan engagement.
sentences.zh: 它们自己也在与收视率下降和球迷参与度降低的问题作斗争。

sentences.en: So viewership for professional sports games had gone down?
sentences.zh: 所以职业体育比赛的收视率下降了？

sentences.en: Yeah, and particularly baseball, where the games were increasingly long, stretching into the three hours, which were seen as driving away fans.
sentences.zh: 是的，尤其是棒球，比赛时间越来越长，长达三个小时，这被认为在把球迷赶走。

sentences.en: You know, the idea that these games are long and boring.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这种观点认为这些比赛又长又无聊。

sentences.en: And some baseball executives started to think that maybe sports betting could turn the length of the games, which is seen as a real weakness,
sentences.zh: 一些棒球高管开始认为，如果能有比赛中的下注或其他方式让球迷和观众在比赛进行时参与进来，体育博彩也许能把被视为致命弱点的比赛时长，

sentences.en: into a strength if there were opportunities for in-game betting or other ways for fans and viewers to engage with the games as they were ongoing.
sentences.zh: 变成一种优势。

sentences.en: You know, if you have like three hours worth of potential in-game bets, hey, maybe that's not such a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你有大约三个小时的潜在局内下注时间，嘿，也许这并不是一件坏事。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And it's also kind of plugging into the way Americans live their lives these days, right?
sentences.zh: 而且这也顺应了美国人如今的生活方式，对吧？

sentences.en: We're all on our phones all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们无时无刻不在看手机。

sentences.en: But I thought the leagues had been opposed to this forever because they were worried that once gambling started to happen, people would stop trusting the integrity of the game.
sentences.zh: 但我以为各大体育联盟一直以来都反对这样做，因为他们担心一旦赌博开始盛行，人们就会不再信任比赛的公正性。

sentences.en: So what happened to that?
sentences.zh: 那后来怎么又变了呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, those worries still remain, and publicly this was definitely a reversal, but they basically saw that this was something that was coming,
sentences.zh: 对，这些担忧依然存在，而且从公开层面来看，这绝对是一个180度的大转弯，但他们基本上看清了这是大势所趋，

sentences.en: and they figured that they might as well use it to try to increase fan engagement and also to make some money.
sentences.zh: 于是他们觉得不如顺水推舟，利用这一点来提高球迷的参与度，还能顺便赚点钱。

sentences.en: Okay, so the leagues are starting to come around.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也就是说各大联盟开始转变态度了。

sentences.en: Obstacle number one, they're starting to overcome that.
sentences.zh: 第一个障碍，他们开始克服了。

sentences.en: What about obstacle number two, the federal ban?
sentences.zh: 那第二个障碍呢，联邦禁令？

sentences.en: Yeah, at the same time as fantasy sports was growing as an industry and winning approval in state houses, there was this whole other parallel track dealing with the federal ban,
sentences.zh: 对，就在梦幻体育作为一个产业不断发展并在各州议会获得批准的同时，还有另一条并行的轨道在处理联邦禁令的问题，

sentences.en: and it emanated from New Jersey, where in 2012...
sentences.zh: 这起源于新泽西州，在2012年的时候……

sentences.en: Gambling is now legal in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州的赌博现在合法了。

sentences.en: Governor Chris Christie signed the measure into law yesterday.
sentences.zh: 州长克里斯·克里斯蒂昨天签署了这项法案成为法律。

sentences.en: The governor at the time, Chris Christie, had signed into law a bill that would have legalized sports betting.
sentences.zh: 当时的州长克里斯·克里斯蒂签署了一项旨在将体育博彩合法化的法案。

sentences.en: The idea is to boost state coffers and help Atlantic City casinos, which will offer their own online games.
sentences.zh: 此举旨在充实州财政，并帮扶将提供自家在线游戏的亚特兰大城赌场。

sentences.en: His goal was much less ambitious than online sports betting that we see today.
sentences.zh: 他的目标远没有我们今天看到的在线体育博彩那么宏大。

sentences.en: It was to revitalize Atlantic City, where the casinos on the boardwalk were struggling mightily.
sentences.zh: 他的目的是振兴亚特兰大城，当时海滨大道的赌场正举步维艰。

sentences.en: The idea was if you brought sports betting in, it would bring more people in intereSt.
sentences.zh: 当时的设想是，如果你引入体育博彩，就会吸引更多人来关注。

sentences.en: There was just one little itty-bitty, teeny-tiny problem with the governor's idea.
sentences.zh: 州长的这个设想只有一个小小的、微不足道的、极小的问题。

sentences.en: It's illegal.
sentences.zh: 它是非法的。

sentences.en: But that effort to legalize sports betting was an open defiance of the federal ban.
sentences.zh: 但这项将体育博彩合法化的努力是对联邦禁令的公开蔑视。

sentences.en: So this resulted in a court case that, after many appeals and rulings against New Jersey, made its way up to the Supreme Court, which in 2018...
sentences.zh: 因此，这引发了一场诉讼。在经历多次上诉以及对新泽西州不利的裁决后，案件最终上诉到了最高法院，并在2018年……

sentences.en: The court struck down a federal law that banned gambling on sports games in most of the country.
sentences.zh: 法院推翻了一项在全国大部分地区禁止体育博彩的联邦法律。

sentences.en: Ruled in New Jersey's favor.
sentences.zh: 裁决对新泽西州有利。

sentences.en: Striking down the ban is unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 推翻该禁令是违宪的。

sentences.en: Paving the way for the legalization of sports betting in all 50 states.
sentences.zh: 为全美50个州将体育博彩合法化铺平了道路。

sentences.en: And sending the issue back to the states to decide whether they wanted to legalize sports betting.
sentences.zh: 并将该问题发回各州，由其自行决定是否要将体育博彩合法化。

sentences.en: The future of sports gambling in America is about to change in a big way.
sentences.zh: 美国体育博彩的未来即将发生重大改变。

sentences.en: So federal ban is gone.
sentences.zh: 所以联邦禁令取消了。

sentences.en: That's, of course, obstacle number two.
sentences.zh: 这当然就是第二个障碍。

sentences.en: Presumably opening up the floodgates, right?
sentences.zh: 想必接下来就要全面放开了，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, isn't this the moment that Jeremy Kudan and all the lobbyists in the industry are waiting for?
sentences.zh: 比如，这不正是杰瑞米·库丹和业内所有游说者一直在等待的时刻吗？

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百是的。

sentences.en: They had the relationships with the lawmakers that they had built through the fantasy sports fights.
sentences.zh: 他们通过在梦幻体育博弈中建立的关系，已经与议员们打好了交道。

sentences.en: They had the leagues basically on board with them.
sentences.zh: 各大联盟基本上也与他们站在了同一阵线。

sentences.en: And now they had the green light from the Supreme Court overturning this law and throwing the decision on whether to legalize sports betting back to the states.
sentences.zh: 现在他们又得到了最高法院的绿灯，最高法院推翻了这项法律，并将是否将体育博彩合法化的决定权交还给了各州。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日电子简报《交易册》商业与政策板块的报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市“交易册峰会”的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界的一些最具影响力的领袖，其中包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于NYTimes.com上对精选访谈进行现场直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: Okay, so the floodgates are now open.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在全面解禁了。

sentences.en: The states now have the power to decide whether sports betting should be legal.
sentences.zh: 各州现在拥有了决定体育博彩是否非法的权力。

sentences.en: And the sports betting companies and Jeremy Kudon and other lobbyists are ready to go.
sentences.zh: 体育博彩公司、杰瑞米·库丹以及其他游说者已经准备就绪。

sentences.en: What do they do first?
sentences.zh: 他们首先要做什么？

sentences.en: The lobbyists leap into action, targeting some of these states where they think they have a real shot at getting sports gambling legalized
sentences.zh: 游说者们立即行动起来，将目标锁定在他们认为很有希望将体育博彩合法化的那些州，

sentences.en: and where they have relationships with the lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 并且他们在那里与议员们有着良好的关系。

sentences.en: The industry and its lobbyists went to great lengths to wine and dine these lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 该行业及其游说者不遗余力地用美酒佳肴招待这些议员。

sentences.en: Take Kansas, for example.
sentences.zh: 以堪萨斯州为例。

sentences.en: My colleague Eric Lipton got into a cigars, cars, and bars party.
sentences.zh: 我的同事埃里克·利普顿混入了一个名为“雪茄、汽车与酒吧”的派对。

sentences.en: Oh boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: In the shadow of the state capitol, which lobbyists for the industry literally wine and dine these lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 就在州议会大厦的阴影下，该行业的游说者们就在这里赤裸裸地用美酒佳肴招待这些议员。

sentences.en: The invitation advertises premium prime rib and seafood buffet, huge dessert sampling station, wine tasting, craft beer tasting, fine cigars, single malt scotch.
sentences.zh: 邀请函上宣传的是：优质肉眼牛排和海鲜自助餐、大型甜点拼盘、品酒会、精酿啤酒品鉴、优质雪茄以及单麦芽苏格兰威士忌。

sentences.en: And my colleague Eric Lipton was able to observe some of the lawmakers who were working on the legislation,
sentences.zh: 我的同事埃里克·利普顿得以观察到一些参与立法工作的议员，

sentences.en: smoking those cigars and drinking that scotch and talking to the lobbyists who were pushing the bills.
sentences.zh: 他们抽着雪茄，喝着威士忌，与正极力推动相关法案的游说者交谈。

sentences.en: So literally smoke-filled rooms that we think of in our minds when we hear the word lobbyists in state capitals.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是我们在听到州议会大厦的“游说者”这个词时，脑海中浮现的那种烟雾缭绕的密室谈判。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really out of central casting.
sentences.zh: 对，这真的是教科书般的标准场景。

sentences.en: And I think it underscores this idea that it's a lot easier to mount an effective lobbying or political campaign in a state capitol than it is in Congress.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这凸显了一个观点：在州议会开展有效的游说或政治活动，比在国会要容易得多。

sentences.en: There's fewer reporters watching.
sentences.zh: 盯着的记者更少。

sentences.en: It costs less money.
sentences.zh: 花费的资金更少。

sentences.en: And in a lot of cases, you get more access to these lawmakers who don't have huge professional full-time stabs like we see in Congress.
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，你能获得更多接触这些议员的机会，他们没有像我们在国会看到的那样庞大的专业全职幕僚团队。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Lobbying dollars go a lot further in state capitals than they do at the federal level.
sentences.zh: 游说资金在州议会的作用要比在联邦层面大得多。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And the lobbyists for the sports gambling industry are making one big argument to lawmakers that seems to resonate pretty well.
sentences.zh: 体育博彩业的游说者们正在向议员们提出一个非常有说服力的主要论点。

sentences.en: And it's a pretty common argument that you hear a lot when it comes to legalizing some previously illegal activity.
sentences.zh: 当谈到将以前非法的某种活动合法化时，这是一个相当常见、你经常能听到的论点。

sentences.en: The argument that the lobbyists make is that, hey, sports betting is already happening.
sentences.zh: 游说者提出的论点是：嘿，体育博彩其实已经在进行了。

sentences.en: It's just happening illegally.
sentences.zh: 只不过它一直是在地下非法进行的。

sentences.en: The idea is that this is happening through offshore sites that are doing it illegally or from your local bookie in your corner bar.
sentences.zh: 其核心观点是，这些赌博要么是通过非法的海外网站进行的，要么是通过你街角酒吧里的本地庄家进行的。

sentences.en: And there are not any safeguards here for the people who are gambling.
sentences.zh: 而且对于那些赌博的人来说，这里没有任何安全保障。

sentences.en: They could have their money taken from them, you know, and not get paid out for their wins.
sentences.zh: 他们的钱可能会被卷走，你知道的，赢了钱也拿不到彩金。

sentences.en: They could develop gambling problems and not have anyone watching to see if they're betting irresponsibly and that wouldn't it make sense for you to legalize it and regulate it and therefore make it safer for your citizens and residents who are betting and also make some money off of it by taxing it.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会染上赌瘾，却没有人监督他们是否存在不负责任的下注行为；那么，将它合法化并进行监管，从而为下注的公民和居民提供更多安全保障，同时还能通过征税从中赚取一些收入，难道不是很有意义吗？

sentences.en: And the lobbyists are telling these lawmakers who are quite receptive to this argument that there is $400 billion each year that is bet illegally on sports.
sentences.zh: 游说者们正在向对这一论点相当接受的议员们灌输一种说法：每年有高达4000亿美元的资金被用于非法的体育博彩。

sentences.en: $400 billion.
sentences.zh: 足足4000亿美元。

sentences.en: So they're basically making the case that this is already a huge phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上是在用这个论点证明，这已经是一个巨大的庞然大物了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's a powerful argument, not just because they're suggesting, hey, this is already happening,
sentences.zh: 对，这是一个很有力的论点，不仅仅是因为他们暗示“嘿，这已经在发生了”，

sentences.en: but because of the potential for states to get in on some of this $400 billion and make it work for them.
sentences.zh: 更是因为各州有机会分这4000亿美元的一杯羹，并为自己所用。

sentences.en: So this number starts to get a lot of traction among lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个数字开始在议员中引起广泛关注。

sentences.en: And we started to wonder, where did this number come from?
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始好奇，这个数字究竟是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it wasn't easy to figure it out, but basically it appears as if it was cited by a commission created by Congress in the 90s to study gambling and its effects.
sentences.zh: 要弄清楚这一点并不容易，但基本上看来，它是由国会在90年代为研究赌博及其影响而成立的一个委员会所引用的。

sentences.en: And they cited a guesstimate of between $80 and $380 billion of illegal sports betting each year.
sentences.zh: 他们当时引用了一个粗略估计数，即每年非法的体育博彩金额在800亿到3800亿美元之间。

sentences.en: And somehow it went from a guesstimate to an article of faith among supporters of legalizing sports betting.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，这个粗略估计竟然成了体育博彩合法化支持者们深信不疑的教条。

sentences.en: So essentially the number that was really at the core of the lobbyist's argument was essentially plucked out of thin air.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，作为游说者论点核心的这个数字，其实完全是凭空捏造出来的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's basically right.
sentences.zh: 对，基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: The industry was relying on questionable data to push the argument to legalize sports betting.
sentences.zh: 该行业一直在依靠可疑的数据来推动体育博彩合法化的论点。

sentences.en: And it was successful.
sentences.zh: 而且他们成功了。

sentences.en: So at the end of all of this, how many states are we looking at?
sentences.zh: 那么在经历这一切之后，我们究竟看到了多少个州？

sentences.en: I mean, how many have actually approved this legislation?
sentences.zh: 我是说，到底有多少个州真正批准了这项立法？

sentences.en: Well, over the course of the nearly five years since the Supreme Court overturned the federal ban, and we've seen these states one by one pass laws.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在最高法院推翻联邦禁令之后的将近五年时间里，我们看到这些州一个接一个地通过了相关法律。

sentences.en: Big news.
sentences.zh: 重大新闻。

sentences.en: DraftKings Sportsbook is coming to Ohio.
sentences.zh: DraftKings体育博彩即将登陆俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: Within the last few minutes, Iowans placed their first bets under the state's new sports betting law.
sentences.zh: 就在刚刚过去的几分钟里，爱荷华州居民根据该州的新体育博彩法下注了他们的第一笔赌注。

sentences.en: And just like that, the first legal sportsbook in Kansas was open.
sentences.zh: 就这样，堪萨斯州第一家合法的体育博彩公司开业了。

sentences.en: We're now up to 36 states that have legalized sports betting.
sentences.zh: 目前已有36个州将体育博彩合法化。

sentences.en: Texas lawmakers want to legalize sports betting, and the push is getting bipartisan support.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州的议员们希望将体育博彩合法化，这一推动正获得两党支持。

sentences.en: There are bills pending in a number of the other states that have yet to do so.
sentences.zh: 在其他尚未立法的州，也有不少相关法案正在审议中。

sentences.en: The state hopes legalized sports betting will bring in tens of millions of dollars in revenue.
sentences.zh: 该州希望将体育博彩合法化能带来数千万美元的税收收入。

sentences.en: That the industry is pushing really hard to try to pass.
sentences.zh: 这是该行业正在极力推动通过的。

sentences.en: And once they were able to legalize in each of these states, they launched into these very aggressive marketing campaigns,
sentences.zh: 一旦他们在各个州实现了合法化，他们就会展开非常激进的营销活动，

sentences.en: where the ads blanket the airwaves and are emblazoned on the walls of some of the most iconic sports venues in the country.
sentences.zh: 广告铺天盖地，并印在该国一些最具标志性的体育场馆的墙壁上。

sentences.en: And this is all in the service of trying to attract customers, because this is a new industry, and they're competing with other companies in this space.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了吸引客户，因为这是一个新兴行业，他们正在与这一领域的其他公司竞争。

sentences.en: And one of the things that they offer...
sentences.zh: 而他们提供的其中一项服务是……

sentences.en: Now on FanDuel, get up to $1,000 back in free bets if you don't win.
sentences.zh: 现在在FanDuel上，如果你没赢，最高可获得1000美元的免费下注返还。

sentences.en: ...is these promotions where they offer bettors free bets.
sentences.zh: ……就是向赌客提供免费下注的促销活动。

sentences.en: You stuck in an awkward thing to dinner.
sentences.zh: 你被困在晚餐上感到很尴尬。

sentences.en: You waiting for your groceries to be bad.
sentences.zh: 你在等你的杂货打折。

sentences.en: And these are promotions that are intended to lure new customers who might not otherwise be inclined to open an account and start betting,
sentences.zh: 这些促销活动旨在吸引那些原本可能不愿意开户并开始下注的新客户，

sentences.en: with the idea that, like, this is a starter bet for you.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念是：这只是给你的入门级赌注。

sentences.en: Now get up to $1,000 back in free bets if you don't win.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果没有赢，最高可获得1000美元的免费下注返还。

sentences.en: And bettors can use these credits to make wagers without putting their own money on the line.
sentences.zh: 赌客可以使用这些信用额度进行下注，而无需将自己的真金白银压在上面。

sentences.en: So you can see why this might be appealing to someone who is a sports fan and sees all the promotions, but not necessarily a seasoned bettor.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以理解为什么这会对一个体育迷、同时又不是资深赌客的人产生吸引力，毕竟他们能看到所有的促销活动。

sentences.en: FanDuel.
sentences.zh: FanDuel。

sentences.en: Make every moment more.
sentences.zh: 让每一刻更有意义。

sentences.en: So it's like for people who may not be used to risking money, like, kind of ease into it.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是针对那些可能不习惯冒风险的人，让他们……慢慢适应。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Get your first taste of the action.
sentences.zh: 让你初次尝到博彩的滋味。

sentences.en: And there are many examples of people who win based on these promotions and are hooked, or if not hooked, at least enticed and become regular sports bettors.
sentences.zh: 有许多这样的例子：人们因为这些促销活动而赢了钱，从而上了瘾；或者即便没有上瘾，至少也被吸引住，进而成了常规的体育博彩者。

sentences.en: That's a different phenomenon from moving betting that's already happening illegally into the newly legal and regulated market.
sentences.zh: 这与将已经在非法进行的赌博转移到新近合法且受监管的市场，完全是两种不同的现象。

sentences.en: In this case, it sounds like they were creating a new audience.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，听起来他们是在凭空创造一个新的受众群体。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: So sports betting is really taking off.
sentences.zh: 所以体育博彩真的腾飞了。

sentences.en: There's all this advertising all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都是这样的广告。

sentences.en: Lots of states have legalized it.
sentences.zh: 许多州都将其合法化了。

sentences.en: And the theory was that once this thing really gets off the ground, states would start raking in the tax revenue, right?
sentences.zh: 当时的理论是，一旦这东西真正起步，各州就会开始大把大把地收取税收，对吧？

sentences.en: Like all this tax money would just start flooding into state coffers.
sentences.zh: 就像所有的税款都会源源不断地流入州财政库一样。

sentences.en: Does that happen?
sentences.zh: 情况确实如此吗？

sentences.en: In a lot of states, we found that it didn't happen, that the tax revenues were substantially less than what the industry had predicted.
sentences.zh: 我们在很多州发现并非如此，税收收入远远低于该行业的预测。

sentences.en: And there are a couple reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 这里面有几个原因。

sentences.en: Number one, the initial tax rate was set quite low in a number of these states.
sentences.zh: 第一，其中许多州最初设定的税率相当低。

sentences.en: Ken, what's an example?
sentences.zh: 肯，有什么例子吗？

sentences.en: A really good example would be Kansas, the state that we talked about earlier with the cigars, cars, and bars party.
sentences.zh: 一个很好的例子就是堪萨斯州，也就是我们之前提到举办过“雪茄、汽车与酒吧”派对的那个州。

sentences.en: The initial proposal to legalize sports betting called for a 20% tax rate.
sentences.zh: 最初将体育博彩合法化的提案要求征收20%的税率。

sentences.en: But the lobbyists for the industry said that would depress interest from the sports betting companies and would stifle the market.
sentences.zh: 但该行业的游说者表示，这会压制体育博彩公司的兴趣并扼杀市场。

sentences.en: So the legislators slashed the tax rate to 10%.
sentences.zh: 于是议员们将税率大幅削减至10%。

sentences.en: And on top of that, they also included some deductions for these promotional bets that we discussed.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们还为我们讨论过的这些促销性下注提供了一些税收扣除额。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All those promo bets.
sentences.zh: 全都是那些促销赌注。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so in a lot of these states, the legislation that legalized sports betting allowed for the gambling companies to deduct from the amount that they would pay in taxes,
sentences.zh: 所以在许多这样的州，将体育博彩合法化的立法允许博彩公司从他们需要缴纳的税款中进行扣除，

sentences.en: is the free bets and promotional bets that we had talked about before.
sentences.zh: 扣除额度就是我们之前讨论过的免费下注和促销下注。

sentences.en: So essentially, states subsidizing this promotion.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，是各州在补贴这种促销活动。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全是这样。

sentences.en: And what did that all add up to?
sentences.zh: 那这些总共加起来是多少？

sentences.en: Well, in the months after Kansas legalized sports betting, there were $350 million worth of bets that were placed by Kansans.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在堪萨斯州将体育博彩合法化后的几个月里，堪萨斯人下注的金额达到了3.5亿美元。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And we found that the state collected less than $271,000 on those $350 million worth of bets.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在这3.5亿美元的投注中，州政府收集到的税收不到27.1万美元。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: A tiny fraction of the tax rate they were going for.
sentences.zh: 这只是他们原本设定的税率的一小部分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Not only is it less than the 10% tax rate that was enshrined in the Kansas legislation, it's less than 0.1% of the total sports betting handle.
sentences.zh: 这不仅低于堪萨斯州立法中规定的10%的税率，甚至不到总体育博彩流水的0.1%。

sentences.en: So Kansans really got a raw deal, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来堪萨斯人确实吃了大亏。

sentences.en: And it was mostly thanks to lobbying from the betting industry.
sentences.zh: 这主要归功于博彩行业的游说。

sentences.en: Yeah, there was certainly an element of that.
sentences.zh: 是的，其中肯定有这方面的因素。

sentences.en: The industry says, though, that it's too soon to tell how much will be bet as the market matures and how much these individual states will collect.
sentences.zh: 不过该行业表示，随着市场成熟，现在的投注额以及各个州能收到多少税收还为时尚早。

sentences.en: Essentially, they're saying, give it time.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，他们是在说，给点时间吧。

sentences.en: Has any state made out well by legalizing sports betting?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个州通过合法化体育博彩赚得盆满钵满？

sentences.en: Yeah, a few states have collected a lot more money in tax revenue than the industry projected.
sentences.zh: 是的，有几个州收集到的税收收入远超行业预期。

sentences.en: And the common theme there is that all those states had rejected the industry's advice to tax the gambling company's revenue at 10% and came in with much higher rates.
sentences.zh: 共同点在于，这些州都拒绝了博彩公司关于将博彩公司收入税率定为10%的建议，而是采用了高得多的税率。

sentences.en: The biggest example is New York, which set a tax rate of as high as 51%.
sentences.zh: 最大的例子就是纽约州，其税率高达51%。

sentences.en: And that has really paid off for the state.
sentences.zh: 这确实为该州带来了丰厚回报。

sentences.en: In the first year of betting alone, the state collected more than $700 million in taxes on over $16 billion worth of bets.
sentences.zh: 仅在博彩开展的第一年，该州就从超过160亿美元的投注中征收了超过7亿美元的税款。

sentences.en: So it shows that while the industry had warned that setting the tax rates that high would scare off the sports betting companies and potentially reduce the market,
sentences.zh: 这表明，尽管该行业曾警告称，将税率定得这么高会吓跑体育博彩公司并可能萎缩市场，

sentences.en: obviously that didn't happen here.
sentences.zh: 但显然这里并没有发生这种情况。

sentences.en: Okay, so in other words, New York is a model, you know, tax companies heavily and reap the rewards.
sentences.zh: 好吧，换句话说，纽约是一个榜样，你知道的，重税压榨公司并收获回报。

sentences.en: Well, it certainly seems like it could be a model for other states,
sentences.zh: 嗯，它当然看起来可以成为其他州的榜样，

sentences.en: but many people in the industry and their allies in state legislatures argue that New York's tax rate is too high.
sentences.zh: 但业内许多人及其在州议会中的盟友认为纽约的税率太高了。

sentences.en: They say tax rates like that make it hard for the industry to do business in states.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，这样的税率让该行业很难在各州开展业务。

sentences.en: And there are only a few states with tax rates in that range so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，只有少数几个州的税率在这个范围内。

sentences.en: So can I kind of step back for a second here?
sentences.zh: 那我能退一步先想想吗？

sentences.en: Americans are placing millions of dollars of bets.
sentences.zh: 美国人正在进行数百万美元的投注。

sentences.en: Doesn't that mean fundamentally that it is something that they want to do?
sentences.zh: 这从根本上不就意味着这是他们想做的事吗？

sentences.en: I mean, you know, on the one hand, this is a familiar story of money influencing politics.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一方面，这是金钱影响政治的老套故事。

sentences.en: But on the other, if people want to do it and it's legal, who are we to tell them that they shouldn't?
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，如果人们想这么做而且是合法的，我们算老几，凭什么告诉他们不应该？

sentences.en: Yeah, and we heard that time and again from the lawmakers who are pushing the legislation.
sentences.zh: 是的，推动立法的议员们一次又一次地对我们这么说。

sentences.en: They said, our constituents want this.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们的选民想要这个。

sentences.en: And clearly the numbers bear that out.
sentences.zh: 很明显，数字证实了这一点。

sentences.en: That said, there is a potential public health cost here that problem gambling specialists say is not being adequately addressed.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，这里存在一个潜在的公共卫生代价，问题赌博专家表示这没有得到充分解决。

sentences.en: And tell me about that public health coSt.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那个公共卫生代价。

sentences.en: Well, we don't have a ton of data on it yet because widespread legal sports betting in the United States is so new.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还没有这方面的大量数据，因为美国广泛的合法体育博彩太新了。

sentences.en: But we do have some information that suggests that sports betting is leading to an increase in problem gambling concerns.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实有一些信息表明，体育博彩正导致问题赌博的担忧加剧。

sentences.en: For instance, the volume of calls to the national hotline for people who have gambling problems rose by 43 percent in 2021, according to the National Council on Problem Gambling.
sentences.zh: 例如，根据全国问题赌博委员会的数据，2021年针对赌博问题人群的国家热线电话呼叫量增加了43%。

sentences.en: And this was after a number of states had legalized, right?
sentences.zh: 这发生在许多州合法化之后，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was when we were starting to see sort of a critical mass of legal gambling.
sentences.zh: 是的，当时我们开始看到合法赌博的某种临界规模。

sentences.en: And people who have gambling problems typically are not eager to discuss them because of the stigma, let alone to talk to reporters about them.
sentences.zh: 由于羞耻感，有赌博问题的人通常不愿讨论这些问题，更不用说跟记者谈论了。

sentences.en: But my colleague Rebecca Ruiz and I spoke with more than 20 people who said that they had developed gambling problems betting on sports since this wave of legalization had occurred.
sentences.zh: 但我的同事丽贝卡·鲁伊斯和我与20多个人进行了交谈，他们说自从这波合法化浪潮出现以来，他们在体育博彩中养成了赌博问题。

sentences.en: In other words, this wasn't a result of some sort of illegal betting that they were doing before legalization.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这不是他们合法化之前进行的某种非法赌博的结果。

sentences.en: And a lot of them said that they were drawn in by offers of the risk-free bets, those promos that we talked about.
sentences.zh: 他们中的很多人说，他们是被无风险投注的优惠，也就是我们讨论过的那些促销活动吸引进来的。

sentences.en: And they described feelings of exhilaration as they won, particularly during the pandemic when people didn't have a lot to do as far as entertainment and were sitting at home.
sentences.zh: 他们描述了获胜时的兴奋感，特别是当人们在疫情期间娱乐活动不多、只能坐在家里的时候。

sentences.en: And they had their phones offering this ability to place bets on sports.
sentences.zh: 他们手里拿着手机，上面提供着进行体育下注的功能。

sentences.en: And it was quite entertaining.
sentences.zh: 而且相当有娱乐性。

sentences.en: Sometimes, however, those victories were followed by losses that left them thousands of dollars in debt.
sentences.zh: 然而，有时这些胜利之后接踵而至的是让他们背负数千美元债务的失败。

sentences.en: Yet, they continued to be motivated by this idea that just a few good wagers might reverse their fortunes.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们仍然受到这种想法的驱使，即只要再进行几次好的下注就能扭转乾坤。

sentences.en: We also talked to people who tried to stop and described getting hit up with these promotional offers.
sentences.zh: 我们还跟试图戒赌但描述说被这些促销优惠狂轰滥炸的人聊过。

sentences.en: So in other words, they're trying to stop and they're sort of being lured back in by these offers of free bets.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们正试图戒赌，却又被这些免费下注的优惠给诱惑回去了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And some of the people who we talked to who had these gambling problems said that they didn't know where to turn for help.
sentences.zh: 我们采访过的一些有赌博问题的人说，他们不知道该向谁求助。

sentences.en: And that even when they did, the tools were not particularly effective that were on offer to address their gambling addiction.
sentences.zh: 甚至当他们求助时，所提供的用于解决赌博成瘾的工具也不是特别有效。

sentences.en: So this kind of brings us back to the original pitch, which was legalize gambling so you can regulate it and make it safer.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点把我们带回了最初的推销说辞，即合法化赌博，这样你就可以监管它并让它更安全。

sentences.en: So what did states actually do on that front?
sentences.zh: 那么各州在这方面到底做了什么？

sentences.en: They have passed regulations, but in a lot of cases, there are relatively few protections for consumers.
sentences.zh: 他们通过了法规，但在很多情况下，对消费者的保护相对较少。

sentences.en: And the states have often turned to the gambling industry to help shape those regulations and actually police their compliance with them.
sentences.zh: 各州经常求助于博彩行业来帮助制定这些法规，并实际监督他们对法规的遵守情况。

sentences.en: And so, for example, there are states that require self-exclusion lists, in other databases of people who have asked to be blocked from gambling.
sentences.zh: 因此，举例来说，有些州要求实行自我排除名单，即要求被禁止赌博的人的数据库。

sentences.en: But in a lot of the cases, the states leave it up to the betting companies themselves to download and abide by the self-exclusion lists.
sentences.zh: 但在很多情况下，各州任由博彩公司自己去下载并遵守自我排除名单。

sentences.en: So kind of Fox guarding the henhouse type thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像狐狸看守鸡舍那种事。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we found examples of these companies not abiding by these lists.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们发现了这些公司不遵守这些名单的例子。

sentences.en: For instance, in Indiana, the state created a website that allowed people to block themselves.
sentences.zh: 例如，在印第安纳州，该州建立了一个允许人们屏蔽自己的网站。

sentences.en: But 117 people who had enrolled in that self-exclusion list were allowed to create accounts with DraftKings, one of the big companies.
sentences.zh: 但有117名登记在这个自我排除名单上的人被允许在大公司之一的DraftKings创建账户。

sentences.en: And at least 28 of those people ended up wagering a total of more than $731,000.
sentences.zh: 这些人群中至少有28人最终下注总额超过73.1万美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So these are people who had asked to be banned from betting and were not only allowed to bet, but actually ended up betting a good amount of money.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人是要求被禁止下注的，不仅被允许下注，而且最后还下注了相当多的钱。

sentences.en: In that case, the company was fined, but the punishments are often pretty light.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，该公司被罚款了，但惩罚往往相当轻微。

sentences.en: And some of the state regulators who we talked to told us that while they want to enforce their state's rules,
sentences.zh: 我们采访过的一些州监管机构告诉我们，虽然他们想执行自己州的规则，

sentences.en: they also want to work together with the gambling companies because it's in their state's interest for the industry to succeed.
sentences.zh: 但他们也想与博彩公司合作，因为该行业的成功符合他们州的利益。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: And how are the gambling companies themselves making out here?
sentences.zh: 那博彩公司自己在这里过得怎么样？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm assuming they're doing pretty well from all of this?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我假设他们从这一切中赚得挺好？

sentences.en: No, they're actually not, surprisingly.
sentences.zh: 不，出人意料的是，他们其实没有。

sentences.en: A lot of them are in the red.
sentences.zh: 他们很多人处于赤字状态。

sentences.en: In the red?
sentences.zh: 赤字？

sentences.en: Yeah, most of the big sports books have yet to turn a profit.
sentences.zh: 是的，大多数大型体育博彩公司尚未扭亏为盈。

sentences.en: Take DraftKings, for example.
sentences.zh: 以DraftKings为例。

sentences.en: The company reported late last year that in the first nine months of 2022, it had an adjusted loss of nearly $700 million.
sentences.zh: 该公司去年底报告称，在2022年的前九个月里，其调整后亏损近7亿美元。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And it recently cut a bunch of jobs.
sentences.zh: 它最近裁掉了大量工作岗位。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So explain that.
sentences.zh: 所以解释一下这个。

sentences.en: Well, they spent a ton of money on promotions and trying to recruit and acquire new customers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们在促销和试图招募并获取新客户上花了大笔钱。

sentences.en: And they say that sports betting just overall is not that profitable of a business model.
sentences.zh: 他们说体育博彩整体而言并不是一个那么赚钱的商业模式。

sentences.en: In fact, they see it more as a stepping stone to a potentially much more profitable line of business.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们更将其视为通往潜在利润高得多的业务线的阶石。

sentences.en: And that is so-called iGaming,

sentences.en: which is essentially full online casino gambling that would allow Americans to place bets on poker or blackjack or even slots from their phones or their computers anywhere with an Internet connection.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是完全的在线赌场赌博，允许美国人在有互联网连接的任何地方通过手机或电脑对扑克、二十一点甚至老虎机进行下注。

sentences.en: That's really the holy grail for these gambling companies.
sentences.zh: 这真的是这些博彩公司的终极目标。

sentences.en: So it sounds like in the same way that the industry used fantasy sports betting as a kind of on-ramp to this broader pool of bettors,
sentences.zh: 听起来就像该行业过去利用梦幻体育博彩作为通往更广泛赌徒群体的引流口一样，

sentences.en: the industry is now using sports betting as an on-ramp to this much larger pool of betting.
sentences.zh: 该行业现在正利用体育博彩作为通往这个更大赌博群体的引流口。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And they pretty much acknowledge it.
sentences.zh: 而且他们几乎承认了这一点。

sentences.en: My colleague Eric Lipton and I went to a conference of state legislators in gambling states, and Jeremy Kudon, the lobbyist, was there.
sentences.zh: 我的同事埃里克·利普顿和我去参加了一个赌博大省的州议员会议，游说者杰里米·库登也在那里。

sentences.en: And the keynote address was by the chief executive of DraftKings, and he thanked them for legalizing sports betting but told them,
sentences.zh: 主题演讲由DraftKings的首席执行官发表，他感谢他们将体育博彩合法化，但告诉他们，

sentences.en: it's time for your state to add iGaming, not in the future, but now.
sentences.zh: 是时候让你们的州加入iGaming了，不是在未来，而是现在。

sentences.en: So if more states follow that recommendation,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果更多的州效仿这一建议，

sentences.en: you could see a much larger group of potential gamblers being interested in placing bets on blackjack or slots or poker on their phones.
sentences.zh: 你可能会看到一大批对在手机上对二十一点、老虎机或扑克进行下注感兴趣的潜在赌徒。

sentences.en: And that could also lead to additional challenges for the regulators and the public health apparatus,

sentences.en: which, as we've discussed, is not even necessarily up to handling the surge in gambling and gambling-related risks from sports betting.
